profile.bio: Join millions of coaches, athletes, and teams on the world’s largest recruiting platform.

recentMedia.caption:
The latest FieldLevel app has improved video uploading and more reliable notifications.

And did you know FieldLevel is now available in 46 sports?

Link in bio

NWAC Renews Partnership with @FieldLevel as Official Recruiting Network 🤝 #NWACPartner

Read more about the partnership at 🔗nwacsports.com!

Two-year colleges are a vital part of college athletics. This partnership will help more athletes connect with NJCAA programs and help more NJCAA athletes advance to four-year programs.

Proud to partner with the @njcaa
Summer recruiting isn’t slowing down. From athlete commitments and coach promotions to college coach searches and targeted programs, the FieldLevel network stayed busy last week.

Your camp registration link is all you need to post your camp on FieldLevel.

Paste it in, and FieldLevel automatically imports the details and adds your camp to the map for athletes to find.

Post your camp free on FieldLevel.

#CollegeCamps #CollegeRecruiting
New on FieldLevel: add your social handles to your profile so people can find more of what you share across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

New for coaches: your FieldLevel profile can now show more of your coaching background.

Add memberships and certifications to highlight your credentials, organizations, and continued development.
College profiles on FieldLevel now include more school, athletic, and admissions info to help athletes and families research programs.

Summer camp season is heating up.

College coaches are posting camps across the country on FieldLevel, giving athletes more ways to visit campuses, experience different programs, and work directly with college coaches.

Explore upcoming events on FieldLevel.

College coaches are looking for transfer athletes. Transfer athletes are looking for the right next opportunity.

FieldLevel transfer portal announcements help both sides connect.

Get the FieldLevel app now or check out the link in our bio

New for college coaches: results are now available on camp and event posts on FieldLevel.

See impressions, page views, register clicks, and attendees, for both past and upcoming events.

This is a great time to be active in recruiting. College coaches are watching videos, camps are being announced, and programs still have recruiting needs to fill. There is a lot of opportunity right now.
